profile.name: Oxxius 激光器控制器
profile.description: 用于控制和监测 Oxxius 实验室激光器的控制单元，可切换恒功率或恒电流模式，设置激光电流与输出功率，控制模拟/数字调制，并读取温度、联锁、故障和设备信息，常用于实验室激光光源的集成与运行监测。
profile.description_en: A control unit for Oxxius laboratory lasers. It supports constant-power or constant-current operation, current and output power control, analog and digital modulation, and monitoring of temperatures, interlock, faults, and device information. It is commonly used for laboratory laser source integration and operational monitoring.
